tool_args.rationale: Outputs retain a baseline x_now and show a direction-sensitive step contribution that decreases as H increases. Fit amplitude and relaxation time numerically in the proposed exponential step-relaxation law; the equal-input observation anchors the baseline.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The available fine trajectory batch already spans opposing step directions and horizons; observed outputs support a smooth exponential relaxation, and a fitted confirmation model is preferable to another paid batch.
The equal-input row has nonzero output equal to x_now, contradicting a law based only on the step difference.
The signed response flips with the direction of the input step, unlike the supplied present-snapshot OU mechanism.
It is unrelated to the observed temporal step-response structure and is explicitly unnecessary.
